title: Verify Technician cannot edit work order header fields
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Technician role. (this role has Work Orders = View only - no Create and Edit).
At least one work order exists.
steps:
1. Open a work order.
2. Try to change the Lead Technician in the header.
3. Try to change the Service Advisor.
4. Try to change the Customer.
5. Try to change the Asset.
expected: All header edits are BLOCKED: the fields are read-only/disabled or attempting a change returns a permission error.
